ruling: - **R13.** Owner 16:16 CST Nov 10: "I need it to be that lanes that coordinator spawns are either A) banned from ever having any sort of popup / request that interrupts them, or B) in the artifact i get hyperlinks to those sessions that then show me their erequest and clear them -- I strongly lean towards A though"; 16:17 CST: "trying to make sure u dont misunderstand this into opening a large hole"; 16:18 CST: "yes" to the form. Outcome: a popup inside a lane is a stall the owner cannot see, which costs speed and buys no accuracy. Every popup becomes a refusal plus a routed question, never a silent allow, so safety stays the same or stricter. 1. A lane never opens the question box: a guard refuses it in any session with a parent. The lane sends the question to its parent, triage puts it on the page, and the lane keeps working on what does not depend on it, or ends its turn. 2. A lane starts in a mode where an act not pre-allowed is refused, not asked; the refused act goes to the parent like a question. A builder first confirms the cloud `dontAsk` mode refuses rather than prompts (unverified). 3. An act that needs the owner's typed word (an override, a guarded settings write) becomes a page item; his save on the page is the grant (skill waiting-page). A relay in R18 point 5's form also grants it (R12); any other agent text never grants. 4. Cards no mode can stop (repository trust, computer folder, owner-approval cards): a guard refuses those tools in a lane, and the lane routes the act to its parent. Replaces CLAUDE.md questions-go-to-owner, "The started session may wait on it." Unmeasured: how often lanes have stalled on a popup so far. Home: CLAUDE.md questions-go-to-owner; decision questions-go-to-owner.
